name: proofpulse-vscode
description: See which parts of your Dafny proof actually matter: highlights unused, test-only and vacuous specs, assertions, code and conditions as you save.

proofpulse.useCustomDafny.markdownDescription: Use your own build of the ProofPulse Dafny fork (github.com/VeriFixer/dafny_proofpulse) instead of the downloaded one. A standard Dafny release will mostly not work. When enabled, set `#proofpulse.customDafnyPath#` to your binary.

proofpulse.customDafnyPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `dafny` executable of your ProofPulse Dafny build. Only used when `#proofpulse.useCustomDafny#` is enabled. Can be an absolute path or `dafny` to use the system PATH.

proofpulse.solverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the solver (Z3) the verifier runs with. Leave empty to use the verifier's own default (for Dafny: its bundled Z3).

proofpulse.z3Path.markdownDescription: Path to the Z3 binary used by core minimization. Leave empty to use `#proofpulse.solverPath#`, or auto-resolve from the Dafny installation.

proofpulse.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for Dafny verification

proofpulse.runOnSave.description: Automatically run coverage analysis when a .dfy file is saved

proofpulse.forceMinimization.markdownDescription: Enable unsat core minimization for Z3 solver calls. **Experimental:** tested on Linux (Nobara/Fedora). Not known if well supported on other platforms.

proofpulse.decorationOpacity.description: Opacity for the background of highlighted expressions (0.0–0.5)

proofpulse.showImplicitChecks.description: Also highlight implicit checks the verifier adds (e.g. 'target object is never null', 'index in range'). Vacuous ones are always shown.
